beats.say: Forty-eight per cent of Tamil Nadu's yearly rain falls after the summer monsoon withdraws.
beats.cap: 48% of Tamil Nadu's rain: after the summer monsoon

beats.say: About seventy-five per cent of India's rain falls in that monsoon.
But in those months, IMD says, Tamil Nadu sits in a rain shadow.
beats.cap: June–Sept: Tamil Nadu in a rain shadow (IMD)

beats.say: Then, in October, the summer monsoon withdraws.
Low-level winds reverse, from south-westerly to north-easterly.
Low-pressure systems from the Bay of Bengal drift west, adding rain.
beats.cap: Bay of Bengal systems drift west, adding rain

beats.say: The north-east monsoon takes over: for Tamil Nadu, the chief rainy season.
beats.cap: North-east monsoon: Tamil Nadu's chief rainy season

beats.say: So its biggest rains begin as India's summer monsoon ends.
beats.cap: Its biggest rains begin as the summer monsoon ends
